result:
Every day, there are moments when I just want to forget about everything and bottomless. I just want you to know that I'm here for you no matter what. However, every where you look, it seems like there are a thousand people that don't feel the same way. If that's the case; if that's the way you find it best to cope, that's okay, but I'm here for you, you have my support. You're not in this alone.


Every morning, I wake up just to take a look at the world. At first, my feelings aren't as high as they used to be; instead, sadness and forlornness. I slowly fade in the light of the sun and yet, the dawn brings me peace. Seeing the world being so beautiful every morning gives me hope that although today may be awful, it can still turn around. I just need to keep reminding myself that if I stick with it, I'll make it through.

With faith, I make it through. It's just another day. Besides, a moment can be filled with all its magic to accusations and turmoil. My situations change frequently, but my spirit of reasons does not waver. Every triumph or failure is a lesson towards the main goal. No matter what error I commit, I learn from it, put myself back on track and reach the next goal. Besides, the moment I get back on my feet, I'm free to continue my walk. I'm lucky to have you hope in me always.
